fact: Government Notice 380 of 2024, published in Government Gazette 8530 on 9 December 2024, sets the selection committee terms and the appointment process for the Information Commissioner under section 6(9) of the Access to Information Act, 2022.
title: Regulations relating to terms and conditions of Selection Committee and process for appointment of Information Commissioner and Deputy Information Commissioner
publisher: Government of Namibia (Government Notice 380 of 2024), via NamibLII
